label: LewdCorner
description: Unofficial plugin from gamegrab-sources, not part of droidtop and not affiliated with LewdCorner. Finds LewdCorner games, links your games to their threads, tells you when a new version is out, and downloads them into your game folders with your LewdCorner session.

provides.label: LewdCorner thread
provides.linkHint: Thread link or number; blank unlinks

permissions.reason: Reads LewdCorner's search, forum and thread pages
Lets you sign in to LewdCorner in droidtop's browser view: the site shows download links to members and lets requests through its Cloudflare check only with that session
Tells you when a game you linked has a new version
Games you choose to download are placed in your game folder
